items.item_text: Skill in demonstrating work experience with a database computer program

Front Office Administrative Support professionals play a key role in ensuring a positive patient experience and efficient clinic operations by providing exceptional customer service, coordinating patient appointments, managing registration and insurance verification, and supporting physicians, nurses, and staff in a fast-paced pediatric outpatient setting. This position serves as a vital liaison between patients, families, and the clinical care team while maintaining smooth clinic flow from check-in through check-out.
Answer and manage incoming patient calls, schedule new and follow-up appointments, and coordinate communication between patients and providers.
Verify patient demographics, insurance information, referrals, and authorizations while maintaining accurate electronic medical records in CareConnect.
Register, check in, and check out patients, collect payments, and provide After Visit Summaries and patient education materials.
Support patient care coordination by assisting with appointment scheduling, referrals, ancillary testing, and follow-up communications.
Resolve patient inquiries related to billing, medical records, appointments, and clinic procedures with a focus on outstanding customer service.
Maintain patient confidentiality and ensure compliance with UCLA Health policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
Perform administrative duties including document scanning, record management, mail distribution, fax processing, and maintaining an organized reception area.
Collaborate with physicians, nurses, and clinic staff to ensure efficient patient flow, support clinic operations, and provide coverage during staffing needs.
Ability to communicate professionally and effectively with physicians and staff in a high volume setting.
Skill in using a PC with associated programs including Word, Excel, and Email
Excellent organizational skills and ability to prioritize assignments
Knowledge of major medical insurance plans and types of coverage provided
Skill in efficiently and accurately facilitating the appointment making process, including transportation arrangements and maintain sub-specialty physician schedules
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to coordinate multiple appointments with staff from many clinical services at the UCLA Medical Center
